# Commit message instructions

- Use the format: [emoji] [Scope]: (optional type) short description.
- Scope is the area of the codebase affected by the change (e.g., "UI", "API", "Backend", "Docs", or a path separated by dots: "NeuralNetworks.Core", "Examples.GPT-2.Trainer").
- Optional type is a short description of the type of change (e.g., "fix", "feat", "refactor", "docs", "test").
- Keep the subject line short (preferably under 72 characters).
- Start the subject with an imperative verb where appropriate.
- Do not end the subject with a period.
- Include a body only when it adds useful context.
- Do not mention files individually unless necessary.
- Never invent changes that are not present in the diff.
